slides.title: Route & Cost Optimization Simulation for Rice Aid Distribution
slides.subtitle: Case Study: PT Pos Indonesia, Regional Office III Bandung — West Java
slides.author: Achmad Taufiq Raihan
slides.authorRole: Logistics Management Student, ULBI · Former Intern, PT Pos Indonesia

slides.title: Scale of the Distribution Network
slides.description: The Regional Office III Bandung rice aid program spans dozens of warehouses and thousands of distribution points across West Java — a route network complex enough to warrant optimization.

slides.title: Transport Tariff Column Was Empty
slides.description: The original dataset had no transport cost or tariff data filled in. Rather than a dead end, this gap became the entry point for analysis: a documented cost simulation model built to practice data analysis skills.
slides.highlight: Data gap → entry point for analysis, not a dead end.

steps.title: Route Consolidation
steps.description: Merged shipments sharing the same origin and destination, recalculating trip counts from total allocation — reducing trucks dispatched below capacity.

steps.title: Additional Route Efficiency Simulation
steps.description: Multi-drop routing between nearby points and reallocation to the nearest warehouse, using documented assumption parameters.
